merkle-base-state-mismatch.observation: Two recovered test-consensus-simplex2-pq-finality-e2e-100 errors under whole-suite parallel load show the same one-height mismatch. At 68ea21db4 on 2026-09-22 07:02:35 UTC, StateResolver actors 87 and 77 reported expected fixture state seqno 5 but applied to seqno 4; at efd22ce46 on 2026-09-22 12:46:23 UTC, actor 83 reported expected seqno 23 but applied to seqno 22. The four hashes were independently decoded, but original candidate IDs, BOCs and stacks were not retained. Production defect mechanism: StateResolver's QuerySlotSkipped shortcut could replace a signed candidate's exact parent with available_base. At bc379ec2c the resolver was changed to resolve the exact CandidateId. The actor regression at 1a2f33940 reproduces both original hash pairs under delayed local NotarCert(P) persistence; 528f0864e additionally reproduces them when only a peer holds NotarCert(P) and real Consensus::start_generation triggers resolution. Pre-fix red and fixed green each passed 40/40 for each ordering, with controls, bounded notready and cross-checks recorded in N6-MERKLE-REPRO-20260923.md. On 1e192efce the three branch CI jobs passed and the fixed actor tests passed independently in ordinary Release. This proves a production path can cause and the patch prevents the observed mismatch shape; it does not uniquely attribute either September failure to that path. Keep the incident OPEN for explicit historical attribution and integration-tree disposition.

simplex-restart-origin-state-replay.closure_condition: On one fixed source tree, preserve an actor-level old-red/new-green regression in which a non-zerostate restart Start points at the latest accepted block, a finalized anchor is temporarily not ready, and the resolver replays the persisted candidate chain from its exact predecessor rather than the restart tip. simplex-restart-origin-state-replay.observation: C03/SR1 is a distinct restart-state defect found by deterministic actor testing, not a diagnosis of the September merkle-base-state-mismatch incident. The old resolver used the non-zerostate restart Start tip after a temporarily unavailable finalized anchor and applied an older candidate's Merkle update to that newer base (expected seqno 0, actual seqno 8). The historical incident was a base one block behind, whereas this reproduction makes the base ahead. A local repair derives the replay base from the oldest full candidate's block-header predecessor, preserves exact empty-candidate references, and bounds transient manager reads. Local red/green and fixed-head CI evidence are recorded separately in N6-C03-SIMPLEX-RESTART-ORIGIN.md; this question remains OPEN until the final fixed tree and CI are verified.

simplex-notarize-state-retry-liveness.observation: Mac C09 diagnosed the old actor path at 52de1ac64: transient ResolveState errors missed NotarizeVote because pending_block suppressed candidate redelivery. On a78c95d77, Consensus retries only retryable state errors with bounded backoff while preserving pending_block; permanent/cancelled, SkipVote, competing-NotarCert, V-019 and exhausted-budget controls remain fail-closed. At b269dea99 a same-process four-validator control passed, but its claim of 24 actual first-candidate parent reads per node was wrong: manager reads were tagged from a global candidate after receipt, and could include later leader-base reads. At 61c890546 the requesting CandidateId originates only at try_notarize and is carried through StateResolver to the manager; start_generation has no requester. StateResolver coalesces by ParentId, so the tag attributes the initiating physical read, not every logical waiter. Exact-tree C05 CTest passed 12/12: three nodes each incurred three requester-bound parent reads, persisted one signed vote matching the first candidate's NotarCert, and that candidate's FinalCert signature bytes matched its accepted carrier; the first NotarCert was observed after 206.408 ms. The over-budget fixture set a 24-read cap but observed 12 requester-bound reads per node across more than one second, no original-candidate late vote/certificate/carrier, and a different candidate later accepted. Dropping the requester tag or reducing Consensus retry to one made the named recovery assertions red; applicable mutation patches and source/binary/log hashes are in N6-C05-NOTARIZE-STATE-RETRY.md. This is a co-located actor control, not release-scale evidence; fixed SHA 054ad9ee7 Branch PQ-chain/Python run 36020099728, Source guards run 36020099772, and microbench run 36020099802 all completed successfully; the Branch job ran the C05 selector 12/12. This closes the bounded co-located actor liveness regression only, not P0-5 as a whole or release-scale finality.
